memories.summary: Mara finished a celadon bowl in her pottery practice on 2026-06-02 and felt proud of it, judging it looked like a real object someone would own rather than amateurish.
Mara gave her first pottery piece she loved (a celadon bowl) to Priya on 2026-06-02 as thanks for pulling her through the worst shifts of the year.
